steps.text: In the blood-red glow of the fire, each person is reduced to a vague silhouette, cast over the mottled ruins.
Once they fought side by side, through the valley of the shadow of death.
Yet now, only hatred and animosity remain in their gazes towards one another.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (What happened...?)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (It's like... everyone went crazy.)

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Allaenat!

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Do you even realize the hell I went through getting back here alive? And before I get even a single hot meal, you want me rushing off to the front lines again?

steps.name: Sargonian Janissary
steps.text: Fall back! All of you, fall back!

steps.name: Sargonian Janissary
steps.text: Is this a mutiny?!

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Mutiny? I'm gonna kill you, ayyuha al'ahmaq.

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Grab him! Don't let him get away!

steps.name: Sargonian Janissary
steps.text: Move it! Out of the way!

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Heavyrain! Quick!

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Stop him! Don't let him run!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (I think I know who he is...)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (What was he called again?)

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: What are you spacing out for?! Kill him!

steps.name: Sargonian Janissary
steps.text: MOVE!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Urgh!

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Damn it!

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Heavyrain, how could you let him get away?!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (All my comrades are staring at me. They look so hostile.) I'm sorry.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (It's like... I'm their enemy now too.) But I don't hurt my comrades.

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Comrades? Heh...

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: You think any of those sacks of shit on our side?
His punch hits Heavyrain square in the face.
The veteran pants insatiably, just waiting for Heavyrain to hit back, dying to vent his anger in combat.
But she doesn't. She simply picks up her shield, her expression calm.
No hesitation, nor any show of fear.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: I'm sorry.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: But I will never hurt my comrades.

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: *spit*! Coward.

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: Enough! This is no time to be screwing with our own.

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Boss, we should make a break for it.

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: While we still have the chance.

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: Run? What about our families back home?

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: We're all brothers from the same hometown. If the lord ameer ever feels like going after them, his job will be easy.

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Allaenat!

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Those bastards were never going to let us live in the first place.

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: I told you to think before you act. Do you regret it now?

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: I can't take this. I can't watch my brothers be thrown out to die like this.

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: Enough, words won't solve this anymore. They can defend the entrance for now.

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: The janissaries and officers are all the children of nobles. With them as hostages, whoever's outside... won't be so quick to act.

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Right.
The years-long campaign has taken these people—far from their homes and their families—and left them with no one but their fellow troops.
It's only natural for those from the same hometown to look after one another, unable to bear their companions suffering even the slightest abuse.
But under such innately oppressive circumstances, strife still remains common.

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: You cowards screwed up last time by being the first to run. I had the enemy tear at my ass for three whole days before I made it out.

steps.name: Dispirited Straggler
steps.text: Khalas! Who are you calling a coward?!

steps.name: Dispirited Straggler
steps.text: If it wasn't for you shit for brains, I wouldn't even be trapped in here!

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Say that again, ya waghadi?

steps.name: Dispirited Straggler
steps.text: Wanna go, huh? Bring it! Put your money where your mouth is!

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Fine, let's go!

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Not going to help? You're just going to watch?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Who would I help?

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Who do you care about more?

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Then who do you think is in the right?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: They... none of them.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Sargonian mercenaries shouldn't be fighting each other for no reason like this.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: ...*sigh* I knew you weren't like the others, Heavyrain.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: There's no should or shouldn't when it comes to soldiers...

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Only want or don't want, obey or disobey.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: How come you got even less food than me?

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Don't vets get a little more?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: It's fine. It's enough.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Having more or less doesn't make a difference.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Anum sort of looks like she's in despair.)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Is she worried for me?)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Anum.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: To tell the truth...

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: I knew the person who ran this afternoon.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: You did? But the janissaries never associate with people like us.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: In our last battle, it was me who pulled him out from a pile of bodies.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: He told me his name was Ibrahim.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: We hid from the Casters pursuing us together.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: So he's your friend?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Not a friend. A comrade.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: What's the difference?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: ...It's hard to put in words.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: But they're not the same.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Do you remember how this whole mess started?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: The officer got the order to send everyone back to the front.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: And then?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: The veterans felt they were too injured from the last battle and wanted more supplies and rest. Then it got out of hand.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: So, who do you think was in the right?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: I understand what the veterans are thinking, but...

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Regardless, you hesitated.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: And to the others, it felt like a betrayal.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: I'd never betray anyone.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: I just don't understand...

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: We save him one moment, and then we have to kill him the next.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Then what if it was someone else running toward you back there?

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Someone who'd clashed with you before, even.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Would you retaliate then? Would you want to?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: If I said no, would you think I'm a coward, Anum?

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: No... Because I knew you'd say that.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: You see everyone as a comrade.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Because we are. Because we're Sargonian soldiers. Because we swore an oath.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: 'Never kneel to the enemy in the face of danger. Never abandon your comrades in times of need.'

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Personal grudges and desires... don't really matter to me much.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Look at this food they gave us!

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: You could turn the plate upside down and it wouldn't fall off!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Stop messing with it. If it does fall, you'll have nothing to eat.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Mm-hmm.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: If that happened, would you give me yours?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Because I'm your comrade?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Because you're my friend.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Friend, comrade... you keep repeating those words.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Is there really a difference?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Yes.

a.text: Devotion? Honor? Oaths? Is there a point?
Can you rebels inside hear me?!
Everyone here is an ordinary Sargonian! We fight to put food on the table, to support our families. That's all we want!
Drop your weapons and surrender immediately! Free the hostages!
You don't even care how many of our brothers died in that battle.
Fine... we're all dead either way.

steps.text: Heavyrain.
Wake up.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Hostiles?!)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (No!) What happened?!

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Lower your blade...

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: It's me, no need to panic.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Dammit... that was too dangerous.) Oh...

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Good thing I didn't hurt Anum.) I'm sorry.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: It's fine. But I need your help right now.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Come with me.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Here's the situation. Neither of their fevers are breaking, and they've been shaking the whole time.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: If we don't cure them ASAP, they're dead for sure.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Their wounds haven't been treated at all.)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (There's so much rot.) What do you need me to do?

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: The vets are watching all the supplies, and refuse to help in any way.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: I assume you know where they keep them. Can you think of a way to bring anything back?

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: They're your comrades, after all.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Comrades...) You don't need to convince me.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Did she really have to stress it like that?) I'll go and try.

steps.name: Dispirited Straggler
steps.text: If you didn't stop me just now, I swear I would've taken them on.

steps.name: Dispirited Straggler
steps.text: Can we trust her?

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Have faith. Heavyrain's a good person.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: She gave her word, so she'll do it.

steps.name: Dispirited Straggler
steps.text: A good person?

steps.name: Dispirited Straggler
steps.text: There's no such thing as a good person in the army, only fools and idiots.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: True.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Who's there?!
Shit, we've been noticed!
Deal with them! Don't make too much noise.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Wait! We're in a tough spot too!

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: So... can we make a deal?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (So dark...)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (I know this is where they put the medicine...)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (These are the bandages, so the disinfectant should be right next to them.)
Who's there?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Oh, no... I can't let them find me.)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Just hide this stuff in my clothes...)

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: What was that noise?! Who is it?!

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: I'm looking for something.

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: Heavyrain, was it meds you took?

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: All by yourself?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (He's turning off the lights?)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (What is he going to do?!)

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: Relax, you don't want anyone else finding you here, right?

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: Okay, so what's going on? Who's hurt?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Should I tell him?)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (If I just leave, will he stop me?)

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: If you don't want to say... the door's over here. Be sure not to make any more noise.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Two recruits have... untreated wounds. They have high fevers.

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: What meds did you take?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: These.

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: Hm... disinfectant and bandages. You know how to treat wounds, then?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Yes. I've learned before.

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: Good. Remember to remove anything that's rotting.

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: We're out of anesthetics... They'll just have to grin and bear it.

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: Take these antibiotics too, they'll be key to saving their lives. That's about all I can give you, though.

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: Obviously, it'd be best to get them to a hospital. But clearly that's not on the table.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Thank you...

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: See you, then.

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: Wait, Heavyrain.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: Are you hurt? Do you feel bad anywhere?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: *sigh*... I remember trying to reason with your mother, when she handed you over to me.

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: You were barely out of diapers...

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: Never mind. Hurry. Stay out of sight on your way back.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Can I ask something?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Abi?

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: Huh? What?

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: Where's this coming from? You haven't called me that in years.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: We swore, before, that we'd root out all of Sargon's enemies.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: But now it's Sargonian soldiers surrounding us.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: It's Sargonian soldiers we're holding hostage.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Everyone here's a Sargonian soldier, and they fight each other every day.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Who is our enemy? What is an enemy?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: What do I... do?

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Heavyrain.

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Let me ask you something first.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: If I was hurt, you would help me too, wouldn't you?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Definitely.

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Because we're Sargonian soldiers. We never abandon our comrades.

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Then suppose I wasn't your comrade, and I wasn't wearing this uniform.

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: I was just some stranger, begging for your aid. Would you help me?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Then what if I asked you to risk your life to rescue me?

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Put everything on the line to help a stranger. Would you?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: I don't know.

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: To put it frankly, serving Sargon, eh... it just means you wear these clothes. Seems like they're all that ties us together.

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: But even without them, you'd still be you, I'd still be me, and anyone'd still be anyone. Everyone has their own identities, their own perspectives, their own goals.

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Even you. You have little ideas of your own, don't you? You'd risk your life to steal meds for your comrades.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: ...was only doing it because...

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Hahaha, I know.

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: You're a good kid. You regard every soldier as an comrade.

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: But what about if you took off the uniform? Who are you then?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (If I left this uniform behind, if I wasn't a Sargonian soldier anymore...)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (What would I do?)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Go home?)

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Enough, I'd better get back to checking on the lookouts.

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Heavyrain... take care of yourself.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: I will...

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Abi.

steps.name: Sargonian Janissary
steps.text: We can execute traitors on the spot. What matters most is we ensure the hostages are safe.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Will you keep your word? That if we work with you...

steps.name: Sargonian Janissary
steps.text: If you're willing to turn back and cease this crime of betraying the lord ameer...

steps.name: Sargonian Janissary
steps.text: Then I trust our superiors will reconsider your punishment.

steps.name: Dispirited Straggler
steps.text: ...They... We all got dragged into this, no one asked us.

steps.name: Dispirited Straggler
steps.text: We never intended to betray the lord ameer!

steps.name: Sargonian Janissary
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Dispirited Straggler
steps.text: I swear!!!

steps.name: Sargonian Janissary
steps.text: The only thing that matters is how you choose to act.

steps.name: Timid Recruit
steps.text: Anum, someone's coming!

steps.name: Sargonian Janissary
steps.text: We can't wait for you forever.

steps.name: Sargonian Janissary
steps.text: Make up your minds.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: I'm back. How are they?

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Still running a high fever. Did you find the meds?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Yeah. Help me redress their wounds.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: They need to tough it out. I have to cut away all the rotting parts.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Then get them to take these antibiotics.

steps.name: Gutless Recruit
steps.text: Heavyrain...

steps.name: Gutless Recruit
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: It's nothing.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Anum, come and help me undo their old bandages.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: You treat their wounds. I'll get some people to fetch things.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: (Whisper) You, all of you, come with me.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: This is our last chance. Are you in?

steps.name: Timid Recruit
steps.text: But the veterans...

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: You're scared, aren't you?

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Do you want to die here? With those idiots?

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: How about the rest of you, then?

steps.name: Dispirited Straggler
steps.text: ...Do you really think we have a chance? It's not like we outnumber them.

steps.name: Dispirited Straggler
steps.text: And will the lord ameer really let us go?

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: You said it yourself, didn't you? What's the difference between us, when we all make our livings as soldiers?

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Or do you want to explain to the people outside how you're innocent while they have a blade against your throat?

steps.name: Dispirited Straggler
steps.text: (Deep breath)

steps.name: Dispirited Straggler
steps.text: Khalas! Fine. Lead the way.

steps.name: Dispirited Straggler
steps.text: Your friend there, is she going to help us?

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Heavyrain... I'll ask her.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: If it comes down to it...

steps.name: Dispirited Straggler
steps.text: You're going to kill her? Isn't she your friend?

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: She is, and a good person too.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: But she can never figure out where she stands, or what matters. She's too nice to everyone.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: You said it yourself, didn't you?

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: There's no such thing as a good person in the army, only fools and idiots.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Right?

steps.name: Dispirited Straggler
steps.text: You got me there.

steps.name: Timid Recruit
steps.text: What... What are you looking at me for?!

steps.name: Timid Recruit
steps.text: I... I'll go with you.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Their wounds are redressed now, and they've taken the drugs.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Their foreheads aren't as hot anymore.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Something's not right about Anum's expression.) They'll recover.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Heavyrain.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: If the war ends, and you leave the army, what would you want to do?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Where's this coming from?)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: I... haven't thought about it.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: You've really never considered what you want to do? Or who you care about?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: What I want to do...

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Who I care about...

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: You.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: And everyone else...

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Oh, honestly, Heavyrain.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Everyone here is gauging me. They're looking to see how I react.)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (And they're packing their gear.)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Anum, if there's something you want to say...

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: You can just tell me.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Then if I asked you to help me capture the mutinying soldiers, would you say yes?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Regardless of what you think, you're out of options. We're all enemies of Sargon at this point.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: But just now, we were lucky enough to get one last chance.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: We can survive this.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Is that really lucky?)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Survive...)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (For a reason like that, and nothing else...) Is there no other way?

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: You can't avoid the problem anymore.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: You treat them as comrades, but they don't see you that way.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Do you still not get it?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (The way they treat me...) I do.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (...doesn't really matter...) But I don't mind.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: I just can't do it. Not when it's just to survive.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Then I'll do it for you.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Am I too weak...?) Anum!

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: I'm sorry.

steps.name: Dispirited Straggler
steps.text: Hyah!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Ugh!

steps.name: Dispirited Straggler
steps.text: Are we killing her?

steps.name: Dispirited Straggler
steps.text: I'll be honest, I've been afraid of you stabbing me in the back at some point.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Tie her up.

steps.name: Timid Recruit
steps.text: Right... She did save our lives, after all.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Heavyrain, you were never weak. You're just shackled by that oath of yours.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: The lord ameer doesn't want you to have your own desires. The officers are scared of seeing your hatred.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: You're a good person.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: So this time, I'll do it for you.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: But you owe me one.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Because you promised you'd protect me.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Because I want to survive.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: I want to survive with you.

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: What's that little wench's problem?

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: She's been with us for half a year now and she still doesn't talk. She just stands there by herself, watching us.

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Children are scared of strangers.

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: She's a good person, once you get to know her.

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Girl!

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Get over here, help us out.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Does he mean me?)

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Go, take this roll call. You see that lost-looking bunch over there?

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Them. Go fetch those recruits.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (It's another new batch.)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (It hasn't been a month since the last one.) Okay.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Hey.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Are you a vet here?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (She's younger than me.)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: You see this gold star?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: This is a spoil of war. I got it from some ruins.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: I'll give this to you, so protect me if they try to bully me, okay?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Huh? Because I hear the vets always bully the new recruits here.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: But from where I'm standing, you seem different.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: No, I mean, why give this to me?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: It's yours. I don't need it.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: And besides, I wouldn't bully my own comrades.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: You're a weird one.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: I'm Anum.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: ...I'm Heavyrain.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Now, back to your unit, please.
The choking scent of smoke—and the familiar-yet-terrifying battle cries—bring Heavyrain out of her daze in a snap.
Instinctively, she tries to reach for her weapon, but quickly discovers that she has been bound fast to a pillar.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Dammit... Anum, you impulsive bastard...)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (I have to find her...)
Tear gas fills the room.
Heavyrain grits her teeth and after some effort dislocates her own arm to writhe it free of the rope. Her clenched jaw manages to stop her from screaming in pain.

steps.name: Sargonian Janissary
steps.text: Death to the rebels!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (No matter what, I need to find Anum, and Abi.) Anum!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Anum... where is she?) Abi!

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: (Heavy breathing) Huff... huff...

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Hahaha, we're all comrades, huh?

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: *spit*! You betrayed us after all.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Betrayed?) You...

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (I didn't...) I'll treat your wounds.

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Stay back!

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Haram alayk, trying to trick me like the hypocrite you are.

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: You think I'm your path to glory?

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Bring it!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (We lived and died as comrades...)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Now we fight to the end as enemies?)

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Allaenat, I'll go out with honor!

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: And you? Selling out your own comrades to survive?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (I was never going to sell anyone out...)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Everyone's treating me as an enemy...)

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Honor? Oaths? You're nothing but a coward!

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: You're just scared to do wrong, scared of being blamed, scared to be a bad person.

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: And for what? Even if my brothers choose wrong, I'd still give everything I have for them! I don't fear it!

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: There's no true right or wrong when you're a soldier, anyway.

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Come. Aren't you going to kill me?

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Even if I die, I have my brothers with me. Lucky me!

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: What about you? What's waiting for you, even if you survive?

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: *spit*!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: ...You're right.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Heavyrain, you were never weak. You're just shackled by that oath of yours.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: So this time, I'll do it for you.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (My parents always told me to obey, to listen.) I never did wrong at home. I tried hard to show them I was a good kid, but in the end I was still kicked out.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Because our harvest was bad, and we couldn't survive. No other reason.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Oaths, virtue, honor...) I think of everyone as a comrade, and try to help them, and I'm scared of doing the wrong thing.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (...are they really just lies here?) But even so, this is how it all turned out...

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: If it's like you say... there's no should or shouldn't, no right or wrong...

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Just like Anum said.) Then I'm willing to bear it... to bear all of the consequences for Anum.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: I'll protect her.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Forgive me.)

steps.name: Sargonian Veteran
steps.text: Agh!!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (I can just use my shield...) Huff...

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (I don't need to actually kill him.)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Anum!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Where are you?

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Once we have you, this entire clown show will be over.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: We'll all still have a chance to survive.

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: Survive? Aren't you a greedy one...

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: You're not fit to be a soldier of Sargon.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: A soldier?

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: You really think anyone gives a damn?

steps.name: Old Captain
steps.text: Drop dead.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Dammit...) Anum!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (Why did it have to be Abi...) Abi?

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Heavyrain!

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Help me.

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Made up your mind?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (I'm sorry...) Abi, I didn't want it to be this way.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (If there was any other choice...) But Anum's my friend, so...

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: I can't let you hurt her.

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Friend...

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Hahahaha! Come on! Show me then!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Urgh!

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Heavyrain! Watch out!

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: I'm coming!

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Move it!

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Argh!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Anum!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Abi!!!

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: For your friend's sake, eh! Good on you!

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Now again, Heavyrain!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Urgh!

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: You're not going to defeat me just by defending. You know.

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: You're still wavering?

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: You need to protect your friend, and right now, I'm your enemy.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (The worst outcome...)

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Heavyrain! Dammit... ufff...

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Guys! Help us!

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Seize the traitor!

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: *sigh*... Looks like we're out of time.

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: You'll have to forgive me for taking the reins, then.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Hyah!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Agh!!

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Heavyrain!

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: The finishing blow!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (We're going to die...)

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (No!) Aaaaarrgh!

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Come!!!
Abi slashed at Heavyrain. Heavyrain lifts her shield with all she has, every drop of strength poured into her charge against him.
Yet in the single moment her view is blocked...
The old vet...
Turns his blade...
And plunges it into his own body.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: NO!!!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: WHY?! Abi!!!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Why are you doing this?!

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Take my blade.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Take it! Quick!

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: While they still haven't noticed.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: No! I won't!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: The warehouse! There's still meds there!

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Astamaʿa li!

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Al-'aan! I'm telling you to take it!

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: TAKE IT!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Abi...

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Heavyrain, you're a good child.

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: You protect your comrades, care for your friends, even watch out for my useless old ass.

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: I'm so... very happy.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Stop it...

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... If you're willing to see everyone as a comrade, to help them, to lay your personal grudges to rest...

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Then you're so much stronger than us elderly morons... but still... *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Never let yourself be so easily bound. Be firm in your own steps.

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: You're a good child, I trust that.

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: But there are times, when kindness is a little inappropriate, that's all.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: I know...

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Abi...

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Don't let it weigh you down. Whatever else, we need someone left to bring our letters back.

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: After so long away, it's about time we old men... went home.

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: These tags––these comrades... you protect them well. I believe in you...

steps.name: Abi
steps.text: Bring... *cough* *cough*... everyone...

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: No! Abi!

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Dammit... Heavyrain...

steps.name: Sargonian Janissary
steps.text: Move aside! Everyone move aside!

steps.name: Sargonian Janissary
steps.text: Any more fighting, and you'll all be executed on the spot!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Stay away from Anum, or I'll take you on myself!

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Don't be scared, Anum!

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Mm...

steps.name: Sargonian Janissary
steps.text: Enough! Do you not think your crimes are sufficiently grave yet?

steps.name: Sargonian Janissary
steps.text: Unit 0374! You have betrayed the lord ameer, and spurned your soldier's oath.

steps.name: Sargonian Janissary
steps.text: This is your last chance to wash yourselves of guilt!

steps.name: Sargonian Janissary
steps.text: We hope for you to prove your loyalty through your actions in this assignment.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: *sigh*... And here I thought we might have a chance to live.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: I should have expected that the lord ameer was never going to let us go.

steps.name: Anum
steps.text: Now what?

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Don't be afraid.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: Nobody is allowed to hurt you, no matter who it is.

steps.name: Heavyrain
steps.text: (I'll bring everyone home, together.)
